a: Wakai is JagX's locally trained transformer (~80-100M params, 14 layers, dim 576).
Weights live on Google Drive checkpoints/; code is in JagX-ai-v2/wakai/.
Prefer wakai_clean_step_10000.pt for cleaner text; also wakai_final.pt and wakai_step_30000.pt.
Render free tier cannot load the 315MB checkpoint; use packs + Groq online, Wakai locally.
SentencePiece files: wakai.model and wakai.vocab in Drive tokenizer/.
Trained max sequence length is 512 tokens.
Packs for instant facts; Groq for hard reasoning; Wakai for offline generation.
Resume from a Drive checkpoint on Kaggle GPU and copy new .pt files back to Drive.
